subject: ANGL
title: English Language – Form 1
source: School scheme of work by week (30 lessons)

lessons.title: Making new acquaintances: reading and speaking; simple present tense; sounds /æ/ and /aː/
Communicating at school and in the classroom: speaking and reading; sounds /p/ and /b/; present continuous tense
At the market: reading a text about the market place; countable and uncountable nouns; vocabulary
Using different means of transport: speaking and listening; sounds /iː/ and /ɪ/; present perfect tense
Preparing meals: writing about preparing meals; adverbs of frequency
Describing family relations, roles and behaviour of family members: writing short letters; adjectives
Describing household appliances and their positions: speaking, reading a text about a gas cooker; articles
Performing household chores: speaking, reading on household chores; regular and irregular verbs
Celebrating special days and events: reading, the silent /e/, vocabulary
Planning a holiday or leisure trip with family: writing about trips, vocabulary

chapters.title: Module 3: Living a healthy life style

lessons.title: Taking a healthy diet: reading a text on a balanced diet, vocabulary; affirmatives
Preventing diseases and injuries: reading; the imperative; vocabulary
Doing sports to maintain good health: writing letters; nouns and types of nouns; sounds /r/ and /s/
Consulting and meeting a health professional: reading on good health, vocabulary; sounds /z/ and /ʒ/
Getting involved in environmental health issues: reading about the environment; question tags
Preferred work and leisure activities for young people: speaking, reading, vocabulary; pronouns
Movie world: speaking; sound /aɪ/; grammar and vocabulary
Youth activities: games and leisure activities: speaking, reading on sports; sounds /ʊ/ and /uː/; vocabulary
Planning a leisure trip to a museum or party: reading on the national museum and traditional museums; grammar and vocabulary
Visiting the library: speaking; conjunctions

chapters.title: Module 5: People and things around us

lessons.title: Socialising with friends: reading about celebrating the new year; vocabulary; writing
Obtaining information about climate change and global warming: reading, vocabulary, writing short stories
Taking care of the environment: speaking, reading about the environment; auxiliary verbs; vocabulary

chapters.title: Module 6: Discovering multicultural issues and practices

lessons.title: Festivals and cultural activities: speaking, reading on festivals, vocabulary
Discovering multicultural issues and practices: writing; gerunds
Culture and traditional activities
When culture breaks bounds: reading and writing
When culture breaks bounds: speaking and grammar
Tribal customs and cultural practices: reading and speaking
Tribal customs and cultural practices: reading, speaking and grammar
Tribal customs: reading and grammar review (revision)
